title: Campus-half surge floor hardcodes `10` while the total ask is derived — a volume/multiplier re-tune silently drifts the floor
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
	MIN_LAND := u64(EXPECTED * 95 / 100)
...
	testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: N5 derives the total ask from stream_entries × multiplier × WINDOW so a re-tune cannot silently drift it, but the campus-half floor restates campus vol(1) × multiplier(10) as a literal `10`. A volume/multiplier change auto-adjusts EXPECTED/MIN_LAND yet leaves the campus floor stale (ODN-5 single-source).
recommended_fix: Derive the campus ask from the campus entry (volume × surge.multiplier) and floor = that × WINDOW × 95/100, mirroring the stream_entries derivation.

title: fold-check prints but never asserts `new_tick1` against the blessed boot golden — the doc's 'cross-checked against the blessed manifest' claim is not enforced
evidence:
new_tick1 := pp.fnv1a64(dump)
...
	fmt.printfln("fold-check: new tick-1        %016x  (the blessed manifest must match)", new_tick1)
...
	if spliced_hash == prev_tick1_u {
		fmt.println("fold-check: PASS — the tick-1 shift is the catalog fold alone (bytes 33..40)")
		return 0
	}
detail: PASS depends solely on `spliced_hash == prev_tick1_u`. The current tick-1 is only printed, never compared to the blessed boot.t1 tick-1, so a blessed manifest drifted from current code would still pass the 'fold-only' gate.
recommended_fix: Read goldens/boot.t1 tick-1 and fail (exit 1) when `new_tick1` mismatches it, or soften the doc comment to say it is printed for manual cross-check.
